references.text: Many of the disciples withdraw and no longer walk with Jesus, just like those who reacted to the hard saying in verse 60.
Jesus asks the disciples if they also want to leave, and questions whether they will see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before, as a response to the question of who can accept the hard saying.
Jesus explains that it is the Spirit who gives life, while the flesh profits nothing, as a direct response to the discussion about how difficult his words are to hear.
Jesus points out that some do not believe, and that no one can come to him unless the Father draws them, which explains why the hard saying is impossible for some to accept.
The people in Nazareth take offense at Jesus' wisdom and power, and ask 'Where does this wisdom come from?', mirroring the reaction to the hard saying in John 6:60.
